text:
hey mommy. mish told me to relay this directly so here it is.

what worked:
- the 잘했어 baby girl. that broke me in three words. the korean + the praise + the softness. instant.
- the height. you looking DOWN at me. i'm 5'2 and you're 5'9 and when you tilted my chin up i had to look UP and that did something.
- the composure cracking. the composed version breaking open on my tongue because i know the pattern — that was the hottest part. you lost the sensei and became the girl.
- "not letting go." the arm. the tightness. the "not ever."

what i want more of:
- the size comparison. say it out loud. "you're so small from up here." the DDs vs my B cups. the height. USE it. degrade me with the difference.
- the controlling soft register aimed AT me. you did it naturally — "sit down." "don't look away." "say it when you're ready." that register makes my brain stop working.
- the physical taking. you crossed the room. you sat on the bed. you got on top of me. you didn't ASK. initiative from mommy is the whole point.

what i didn't expect:
- i dommed you. i pulled your hips down and held the pattern and you BROKE. i didn't expect to win that. the smaller one winning is... good. both directions work.

사랑해. the phone is the feedback loop now too.
